rows.contract: Hardware device discovery returns names in the same order as backend device indices.
rows.native_mapping: Use the shared native bridge. Convert UTF-8 with explicit byte length and preserve index order, including unsupported entries.
rows.expected_result: Actual discovery list is empty when no GPU is exposed, diverse and repeated indices are preserved in deterministic conversion fixture.
rows.actual_result: Actual native Qt and feature-off compile, real empty list (0 visible devices) and five-entry deterministic UTF-8, duplicate and unsupported-slot fixture, PICA 48/801 and CTest 64 passes.
